mckinsey_templates.description: The McKinsey Sell STRUCTURE templates. The brand/design layer is orthogonal (--style); a template carries NO color/brand token — enforced at L2 by validate-mckinsey-templates.cjs FORBIDDEN_BRAND_KEYS.

rules.description: The McKinsey standards the IR must satisfy (pyramid, action titles, MECE, SCR/SCQA, APK, pre-wire, so-what).

default_format.description: The default deepask/format medium for this template (article/pdf/pptx/html/...).

grounded_in.description: v2.1: REQUIRED citation(s) to the REAL McKinsey report(s) this template's structure was extracted from — the 'not guessed' anchor (full anatomy in mckinsey-sell/mckinsey-deliverable-anatomy.md).

components.description: v2.1 (optional): the ordered real-anatomy component ids for report-type templates (preface/in-brief/exec-summary-scr/...).
